curation.rule: Keep every skill that helps build or review interfaces, copied unmodified with upstream's own visibility (domain skills, better-interface and build-design model-invoked; the procedure skills user-invoked through disable-model-invocation, run as /skill:<name>). Leave out a skill that duplicates what OMPdesk or a built-in pack already does or that would fight pstack or Ponytail routing. An upstream skill in neither list fails the sync until it is curated here. No skill may share a name with another built-in root's: stock keeps one skill per name.

excluded.afk: an unattended hours-long run that commits to a local branch and leaves a report is Autopilot (and pstack's autonomous-run playbook); a second unattended runner would skip Autopilot's guard, board and permissions.
excluded.upskill: mining past sessions for skills, hooks and automations is ai-memory's learning (memory_auto_improve, consolidation); it also reads Claude Code and Codex transcript folders (~/.claude/projects, ~/.codex), not omp's ~/.omp/agent/sessions.

otherSources.jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better: not shipped: the ECC pack already ships a skill named make-interfaces-feel-better (hidden, in its index), and stock keeps one skill per name, so a second copy would shadow or rename one of them; better-ui, better-motion and better-typography here hold the same polish rules in the author's newer family, and a second listed polish skill would compete with better-ui for the same requests.
